selection_rule: Highest mean daily Rank IC on selection, fixed positive direction, no window tuning, select one before check/holdout metrics
comparison: Identical date/ticker mask for all factors, at least 252 historical price changes, volume positive for current and past 63 records and label endpoints, require all factor values and label
boundary: Purge signal dates whose label exit crosses the period end, keep entry dates unchanged
uncertainty: Paired moving-block bootstrap on daily Rank IC difference, 63-day blocks, 2000 replicates, seed 18
secondary: Per-year IC, quintile monotonicity, 5/63-day horizon checks, sub-industry demeaned IC, correlation with momentum
counting: Windows, gaps and labels count each security's own records on the filled trading calendar
limitations: Current universe has survivorship and historical membership bias
Not a claim that 2025+ was never inspected in earlier work
Overlapping forward returns are diagnostics, not portfolio NAV
No fees or executable PnL claim
Historical comparison is not proof of future non-inferiority
